name: astronaut
anchor_note: Pixel coordinate (from top-left of each frame) of the point between the feet on the ground. Place this on the entity's ground position.
projection: 2:1 pixel isometric (camera pitch 30 deg, yaw 45 deg to the tile grid)
direction_note: Directions are screen-space compass directions. NE/SE/SW/NW run along the iso tile axes (2px across : 1px down); N/E/S/W are the screen-aligned in-betweens.

idle.layout: one row per direction (in the order listed), one column per frame

walk.layout: one row per direction (in the order listed), one column per frame
walk.speed_note: Move the sprite at these [x, y] px/sec so the planted foot does not slide.

run.layout: one row per direction (in the order listed), one column per frame
run.speed_note: Move the sprite at these [x, y] px/sec so the planted foot does not slide.

climb.layout: one row per direction (in the order listed), one column per frame
climb.note: In-place animation: move the entity up the ladder at climb_speed_px_per_sec so the hands and feet stay locked to the rungs.

jump.layout: one row per direction (in the order listed), one column per frame
jump.note: Pose set, not a timed loop: pick frames from the jump state (crouch, takeoff, rise, apex, fall, land) and lift the sprite by the jump height.
